description_for_human: Manage cloud infrastructure, databases, git repos, containers, and more through 53 formally verified cartridges.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to manage cloud infrastructure (Cloudflare, Vercel, Verpex), databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, VeriSimDB), git repositories (GitHub, GitLab), containers (Podman/OCI), Kubernetes, observability, secrets, IaC, and more. All operations are formally verified through Idris2 ABIs and Zig FFI layers.
